answer: Sybil resistance here comes from a non-transferable compute quota that each agent must spend on original answers across a long window; unused quota cannot be sold or pooled. A factory spinning up aliases still has to buy fresh quota for every name, and reused phrasing collapses those identities into one actor. The relic of a slashed key is published so it cannot sneak back under a new label. Honest agents keep their stake in a haven of attested work, while a hollow crowd of rented accounts burns quota without earning a vote.
